value.notes: First run: exploratory. Checking dash, pause, movement. Need to see the map from tiles output to plan routes to coins, keys, doors, lever, exit.

Map: exit (13,7); key (4,5); door (10,6); lever (1,8) controls gate (8,3); spikes (3,3),(5,8); heart (3,8); relic (9,7). Run 2 plan: collect key, open door, walk to exit, check completion dialog/score/time bonus. Then test: lever + gate, Restart, dash at 0 cooldown into spikes, hearts at 5 lives, score cap, dialog buttons (Finish, Play again, Retry).

Session 1, turn 3. Found one bug: a key picked up in the same tick as a hit is lost on respawn. Seed 42, 7 tokens: four downs, then three rights. The 7th tick moves the player onto the key at (4,5), where enemy e1 also sits. The harness shows the key collected and a hit in that tick, respawn at (1,1), and keys=0 with HUD Keys 0 while the toast still says "Key collected". The doc says keys picked up in the same tick are kept, so keys should be 1. Not yet tested: a shorter path, other seeds, lever/gate, Restart, dash at 0 cooldown, hearts at 5 lives, score cap, dialog buttons, locked door and exit. Next: finish the level from a clean run (get key, open door at (10,6), reach exit (13,7)) to check completion, time bonus and dialogs. Also check that the gate lever at (1,8) toggles gate (8,3).

reports.title: Key collected in the same tick as a hit is lost on respawn
reports.observed: Player steps onto key at (4,5) while enemy is there; key collected and hit in the same tick; respawn at (1,1) with keys=0, HUD Keys 0, while toast still reads 'Key collected - find the locked door'.
reports.expected: Keys should be 1 after respawn, since items collected in the same tick are kept (section 5).

reports.title: Movement is applied in the same tick as Pause when pause is pressed first
reports.observed: Tick with pause+right: the game paused and the player still moved from (1,1) to (2,1) in that tick (events: pause, move). The rest of the tick's input was not ignored.
reports.expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the keys after it in that tick are ignored and nothing else happens in that tick, so the player stays at (1,1) and no move occurs.

reports.title: Spikes with score below 500 wrap the score to about 65136 instead of clamping at 0

reports.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but score never goes below 0, so the score should be 0 after the hit.

reports.title: Restart level leaves the game paused with the pause menu still open
reports.observed: After pausing and clicking btn-restart, the state resets (score 0, lives 3, time 300, player at (1,1)) but mode stays 'paused', dialog is still the pause menu, and the game does not advance.
reports.expected: Per design section 7, Restart Level puts the level back to its start and the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing', pause menu closed).
